summary: Nasus Pharma Ltd. furnished a Form 6-K on September 14, 2026, disclosing FDA clearance of its Investigational New Drug application for NS002, an investigational intranasal epinephrine powder for anaphylaxis. The pivotal study is planned for Q4 2026 with topline data anticipated in Q1 2027; a prior Phase 2 study showed NS002 reaching the 100 pg/mL plasma epinephrine threshold with median T100 of 1.69 minutes versus 3.47 minutes for EpiPen. No board recommendation, advisor, deal terms, or special-situation mechanics apply; this is a routine clinical/regulatory milestone update, not a transactional event.
